mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_chunk (content, embedding, sparse_vector, metadata, user_id, document_id, version, parent_id, chunk_type, title) VALUES ( #{content}, #{embedding, typeHandler=com.example.langchain4j.repository.typehandler.VectorTypeHandler}::vector, #{sparseVector}::sparsevec, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{userId}, #{documentId}, COALESCE(#{version}, 1), #{parentId}, COALESCE(#{chunkType}, 'CHILD'), #{title} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.content, c.embedding, c.metadata::text AS metadata, c.user_id, c.document_id, c.version, c.parent_id, c.chunk_type, c.title, c.created_at, c.sparse_vector::text AS sparse_vector FROM ai_knowledge_chunk c LEFT JOIN ai_document d ON d.document_id = c.document_id AND d.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.sparse_vector IS NOT NULL AND c.chunk_type = 'CHILD' AND (-(c.sparse_vector <#> CAST(#{querySparse} AS sparsevec))) >= #{minScore} AND (c.user_id = #{userId} OR (NOT #{privateOnly} AND c.user_id IS NULL)) AND (c.document_id IS NULL OR d.id IS NULL OR c.version = d.active_version) ORDER BY c.sparse_vector <#> CAST(#{querySparse} AS sparsevec) LIMIT #{topK}
